text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D after sharp gains may have cut short further upside; I should base sales on my goals and the investment outlook, not gains alone.","Holding through declines without reassessing can let losses grow; I should review whether each stock’s fundamentals and prospects still justify holding it.","I rarely trade, and the account’s value has moved both up and down; I should check in periodically, stay diversified, and avoid reacting to short-term changes."]}
